newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: World churches, Moslem scholars in Iran conference.
newsitem.headline: World churches, Moslem scholars in Iran conference.

text.p: The World Council of Churches, which links 400 million Christians in over 100 countries, will open its first ever conference with Moslem scholars in Tehran on Friday to discuss religion, the ecumenical body said.
The Geneva-based organisation, which groups Anglican, Lutheran, Orthodox and other non-Roman Catholic churches, said on Thursday the meeting would also include representatives from Iranian churches.

"Interfaith dialogue is an important dimension of the work of the WCC. In this case, it occurs against a background in Iran which has seen the assassinations of several Protestant pastors in recent years," it said in a statement.
The WCC said it hoped dialogue "can help create a greater climate of tolerance, understanding and cooperation among people of different faiths in Iranian society and beyond."
Over the past year an Iranian delegation has visited WCC's headquarters and a group from the organisation travelled to Iran to meet Moslem scholars, government officials and church leaders.
